install: touch ~/.bashrc && (sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true) && ([ -d "$HOME/.venv" ] || uv venv "$HOME/.venv") && uv pip install --python "$HOME/.venv/bin/python" -r modal/requirements-bench-data.txt -r modal/requirements.txt && EXPORT_LINE="export PATH=\"\$HOME/.venv/bin:$(pwd)/target/release:\$HOME/.cargo/bin:\$PATH\"" && (grep -qxF "$EXPORT_LINE" ~/.bashrc || echo "$EXPORT_LINE" >> ~/.bashrc) && export PATH="$HOME/.venv/bin:$(pwd)/target/release:$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cargo fetch && cargo build --release
